## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Sayings-Record of Chán Master Kāifú Dàoníng* — a two-juan Northern-Sòng *yǔlù* of [Kāifú Dàoníng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AF%A7) 開福道寧 (1053–1113), Línjì-Yángqí lineage master at Kāifúsì 開福寺. Compiled by his dharma-heir *xiǎoshī* [Shànguǒ](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E6%9E%9C) 善果.

Two-juan Northern-Sòng Chán *yǔlù*, X69 n1353. Dàoníng was a disciple of [Wǔzǔ Fǎyǎn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E6%BC%94) 五祖法演 in the Yángqí sub-lineage.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1090; *notAfter* c. 1150.
